t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep fingers on buttons at all times and always choose a response as it's better than getting nothing.

vb_textbox.text: Try to keep your fingers on the keys at all times and stay foccused during the whole assessment. It is very repetitive so use the full 5 minute breaks if you need to stretch or get a quick drink. Make sure to always choose an option so that you don't lose out on potential points. You have plenty of chances so play around with timing and patterns to see if you can identify any.
